verdict.rationale: Handelsregister/Unternehmensregister is a statutory public company register for searching filings and submitting publications, not a hosted service where users keep their own data. Letting users choose a storage region or residency is therefore a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any user-selectable storage location that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
